Public API allowlist and provider construction hardening are implemented and verified.
All factory methods enforce fixed literal keys with negative type coverage.

Added and exported DisposalError as the public cleanup failure type while preserving AggregateError compatibility.
Resolved both code-review findings and verified the public declaration and runtime message.
Function-valued singleton and scoped services now run supported cleanup hooks.
Resolved the code-review test gap and proved async function cleanup is awaited.
Promise factory values are disposed through their owning singleton or scoped lifecycle.

Addressed review findings: Promise retries preserve error visibility and Promise detection cannot poison lifecycle caches.
Addressed follow-up review findings: cached Promise-like values now have sound native Promise types and then getters are assimilated exactly once.
Published examples now use the shipped API, and automated gates detect API drift.
